articles.summary: After markets close on Mar. 19, Torrid will post Q4 and fiscal 2025 results, then discuss them on a 4:30 p.m. ET call with webcast and replay through Mar. 26.
articles.title: Torrid Announces Reporting Date for Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2025 Financial Results

articles.summary: $1 billion in fiscal 2025 sales and $63.6 million in adjusted EBITDA topped its outlook, even as Q4 sales fell 14.3%. 2026 sales guide: $940M-$960M.
articles.title: Torrid Reports Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2025 Results and Initiates Fiscal 2026 Guidance
